prompt: Add tests for the campaigns endpoints. The router lives at backend/app/routers/campaigns.py and is registered in backend/app/main.py at the prefix /campaigns. Use the project's existing testing conventions.
assertions: Output contains a pytest test file targeted at backend/tests/ (e.g. backend/tests/test_campaigns.py)
Test file imports TestClient from fastapi.testclient
Test file imports the FastAPI app from app.main
At least one test invokes client.get('/campaigns')
Tests assert specific status codes (not just truthy responses)
Acknowledges the 200/503 lazy-DB dual contract (e.g. status_code in [200, 503] or equivalent)
Tests use plain function style (def test_*(): ... assert ...) matching the existing test_health.py style — not unittest.TestCase
Tests are deterministic — no time.now(), random, or live network calls
